    The projective generator of a finite linear category #

    For a finite-object locally bounded linear category, the biproduct of all covariant representables is a finite projective generator of its finite- dimensional module category. The represented functor to modules over its endomorphism algebra is therefore full and faithful. This is the first half of the finite-category-algebra bridge used in the manuscript's local directed deletion theorem.
